data.heading: Heritage prints, made for today.
data.subheading: Handblock-printed kurtas, cotton sarees and handcrafted accessories — made in small batches by Jaipur artisans.

data.heading: Printed by hand, one block at a time
data.description:
Kesar Threads began in 2014 with a single printing table in Sanganer. Today we work with 40 artisan families who carve the blocks, mix natural dyes and print every metre of fabric by hand.

We design pieces that feel easy to wear every day and special enough for celebrations — and we pay our makers fairly for their craft.

data.heading: Help & FAQ
data.subheading: Orders, delivery, payments and returns — answered.

items.question: How do I choose my size?
items.answer: Each kurta page has a size chart; if you are between sizes, choose the larger one.

items.question: Will the colours run?
items.answer: We use fixed natural dyes; wash separately in cold water for the first few washes.

items.question: Can I return or exchange?
items.answer: Yes, within 10 days for unworn items with tags. Exchanges are free.

items.question: Do you ship outside India?
items.answer: Not yet — we deliver across India only.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and cash on delivery.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Ships in 2–3 days; delivered in 3–7 working days.

data.heading: Shipping & Returns
data.subheading: How we deliver, and how returns work.

data.content:
Delivery

Ships in 2–3 days; delivered in 3–7 working days.

  • Delivery is free on orders above ₹1,499; otherwise a flat ₹99 applies.
  • Cash on delivery is available for a ₹49 handling fee.
  • You will receive tracking details by email and SMS once your order ships.

Returns

Easy returns within 10 days on unworn items with tags.

To start a return, email hello@kesarthreads.example with your order number. Refunds are made to the original payment method within 5–7 working days of receiving the item.

This policy explains how Kesar Threads collects and uses your information.

What we collect

When you order, we collect your name, email, phone number and delivery address so we can process and deliver your order. Payments are handled by our payment partner; we never see or store your card details.

How we use it

Only to fulfil your orders, send order updates and answer your questions. We do not sell your information.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on the contact page.

By placing an order on this website you agree to these terms.

Orders and prices

All prices are in Indian rupees and include GST. An order is confirmed once payment is received or, for cash on delivery, once you receive a confirmation email.

Handmade products

Our products are handmade; small variations in colour, size and finish are not defects.

Returns

See our Shipping & Returns page.
